description: This file defines a test class 'GroupPosBasedTest' within the namespace 'FastRoute\Dispatcher' that extends 'DispatcherTest' and provides class name methods for dispatcher and data generator classes related to FastRoute's GroupPosBased implementation.

classes.name: GroupPosBasedTest
classes.description: A test class extending DispatcherTest to verify the FastRoute\Dispatcher\GroupPosBased dispatcher and associated data generator classes.

methods.name: getDispatcherClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the dispatcher being tested, i.e., 'FastRoute\Dispatcher\GroupPosBased'.

methods.name: getDataGeneratorClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name of the data generator used in the test, i.e., 'FastRoute\DataGenerator\GroupPosBased'.
